V. 5.
The daughter of Sion—That is the Inhabitants of Jeruſalem: the firſt Words of the Paſſage are cited from. Iſa. lxii. 11 the reſt from Zech. ix. 9. The ancient Jewiſh Doctors were wont to apply theſe Prophecies to the Meſſiah On an aſs—The Prince of Peace did not take an Horſe, a warlike Animal: But he will ride on that by and by, Rev. xix. 11. In the patriarchal Ages, illuſtrious Perſons thought it no Diſgrace to make Uſe of this Animal: But it by no Means appears, That this Opinion prevailed or this Cuſtom continued till the Reign of Tiberius. Was it a mean attitude wherein our LORD then appeared? Mean even to Contempt? I grant it: I glory in it: It is for the Comfort of my Soul; for the Honour of his Humility, and for the utter Confuſion of all worldly Pomp and Grandeur.
